Container.Name: lightcraft-web
Container.Overview: LightCraft Web is a community-maintained Docker image that provides LightCraft, a non-destructive photo editor, through a browser-based WebAssembly application. It is designed for photo development and image editing, including RAW photo workflows. The web application runs on the user's device and uses browser storage for its local-first library; photographs are not stored in a Docker volume by this container. The container only serves the static web application through NGINX.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: LightCraft Light Craft Photo Editor Photography RAW RAW Developer Image Editing Browser WebAssembly WASM
Container.Requires: No special privileges or database are required. The standard deployment does not require a persistent Docker volume for the web interface. LightCraft keeps its browser library and local application data in browser-managed storage, so browser storage availability and permissions apply. The container serves HTTP on port 8080; use HTTPS through a reverse proxy for remote access and browser features that require a secure context.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: Host port used to access the LightCraft Web interface. The container listens on port 8080.
